assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production pixel-art boss animation spritesheet for a Phaser game. Reference image is the attached original character sheet. Preserve exactly the character's identity, palette, recognizable silhouette, pixel-art rendering, armor, props and proportions. Create NEW smooth motion in a strictly regular 4-column by 3-row grid, 12 complete separate full-body frames, ONE boss only: the stocky forest guardian, wooden antlers and leafy green beard, stone gauntlets, glowing green chest rune. Sheet is landscape 4:3, equally sized square cells, generous transparent padding in every cell. All frames have exactly the same body scale, view angle (front three-quarter facing slightly right), horizontal body pivot, and ground/feet baseline at about 90% cell height. Keep head and torso size consistent from frame to frame. Never crop feet, staff, horns or cloak. NO text, labels, row lines, scenery, solid backgrounds, floor shadows or grid. Real transparent alpha background. Pixelated clean edges. Row 1 (left to right): FOUR consecutive frames of a seamless locomotion cycle: heavy alternating root-foot steps with opposite arm swing and slight shoulder settling. Clearly animate limbs and cloth rather than sliding identical still images. Row 2: FOUR consecutive spell windup frames: gathers green root magic, raises stone fists, then braces ready to lunge; frame1 close to neutral, frame4 a held ready pose. Row 3: FOUR consecutive release and recovery frames: forward lunge/ground strike, recoil, settling, return to neutral; final frame blends back to row1 neutral. Follow through is subtle, no excessive scaling or jumping. Spell aura compact around hands/staff so body silhouette remains legible. This is a runtime sheet, no illustrative presentation.
